scripts.checkpoint: node -e "const db=require('better-sqlite3')('data/collection.db'); db.prepare('DELETE FROM sessions').run(); db.pragma('wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE)'); db.close(); console.log('WAL checkpoint done, sessions cleared, ready to commit');"
scripts.lint: eslint server.js src/ lib/ backup.js gc-uploads.js deploy.js pull.js test/
scripts.lint:fix: eslint --fix server.js src/ lib/ backup.js gc-uploads.js deploy.js pull.js test/
scripts.check: node --check server.js && node --check src/app.js && node --check src/middleware.js && node --check src/helpers.js && node --check src/db.js && node --check src/errors.js && node -e "require('fs').readdirSync('src/routes').filter(f=>f.endsWith('.js')).forEach(f=>{const r=require('child_process').execFileSync('node',['--check','src/routes/'+f],{stdio:'inherit',encoding:'utf8'});console.log('src/routes/'+f+': OK')})" && node --check lib/validate.js && node --check backup.js && node --check gc-uploads.js && node --check deploy.js && node --check pull.js
